_doc: Character SSOT for the shorts (user 2026-10-22: 'the deeper root cause is that the character store is not a single source of truth').
Every generator (gen.py key/seg, anchors_plan.py, codex-imagegen plans) reads identity text and reference sheets ONLY from here via out/shorts/ep01/gen/cast.py.
Sheets are binaries outside git; sha256 pins the approved version. A regenerated or swapped file fails `python3 out/shorts/ep01/gen/cast.py check` (exit 1) and every paid call refuses.
To change a character: make the new sheet, review it, then update sheet + sha256 + prompt here in the same edit and move the old path to deprecated.
Current assets are the active registry items and sets. Deprecated images and superseded_refs are preserved with pins for history only; generators refuse their attachment.

moa.prompt: Moa, a small chubby round character with saturated bubblegum-pink body (exactly the sheet's pink: not pale, not peach, not washed out), cream face patch and cream belly, toddler proportions (head about 45% of body height), a soft perfectly round face like a mochi ball with chubby round cheeks and a round chin (never an angular or squared jaw), two TINY rounded ears like a teddy bear's, only small nubs that barely peek above the beret, pale pink inside, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white highlights, rosy round cheeks, tiny pink nose, a cream knitted beret with a plain teal band and, resting on top of the beret, her Sparkle Goggles: chunky round toy goggles with thick soft glossy orange rims, clear lenses with a faint pink-gold sheen, a short orange bridge and a teal strap around the beret with three tiny star lights at her left temple (grey when unlit, warm gold when lit), a teal neckerchief, a short round white tail. Her ears never grow tall, never stand up long, never flop. Same character in every shot; she keeps these colours in the soft pastel 3D world. Character bodies have a smooth soft-touch toy surface, continuous even colour and broad gentle satin highlights.
moa.voice: wordless only: a soft giggle, a little gasp, a curious "hmm?", a sigh, hop footsteps
never: an orange starfish clip or any pin on the beret
a watch, wristband, bracelet or any accessory beyond the beret, goggles and neckerchief
beams or rays coming out of the goggles
stars on the beret itself or anywhere except the three star lights on the goggle strap (H02 t1 2026-10-26 added three gold stars on the beret dome)
moa.wardrobe: She wears only her cream beret (plain teal band, no clip or pin), her orange Sparkle Goggles resting on the beret (pulled over her eyes only when a shot says so) and her teal neckerchief; her paws, wrists and arms are bare pink fur, with no watch, wristband, bracelet, glove, bag or any other accessory.
moa.prompt_note: No 'bunny'/'rabbit' in prompts (RCA 2026-10-22 A1 t5: the word pulls Omni to long rabbit ears even with the sheet attached). The story still calls her a rabbit; only the generator text avoids the word.

cottage.role: Approved Scoop Sky hill set: exact layout and colours; contains no character.
cottage.idle: Background idle loop, running for the whole shot at one steady pace: a soft continuous curl of soft white puffs rises from the chimney and drifts gently right; the spoon pinwheel stays planted in exactly the same spot on its pretzel stick and only its four spoon-shaped blades turn slowly and steadily in place; the scoop mailbox never moves, turns or opens, only its little pink flag gently wiggles; tree leaves rustle while staying on the branches (no leaves fall or fly); flowers and grass nod in place; clouds drift slowly to the right; the floating island bobs gently up and down. Every prop keeps its exact position, size and facing from the first frame; nothing appears, pops out, falls or flies unless the action names it.
cottage.idle_note: user 2026-10-22: the background read as a still image; idle animation like a game's idle state. RCA flying pinwheel: the A1 action asked for butterflies and for the pinwheel to 'start to turn' while it was absent from the first frame. RCA A2 t7: 'leaves rustle' produced flying leaves and the mailbox turned (its facing differed between K2A and K2B) -> each idle motion is bound to its object and states what must NOT move.
cottage.still: Soft white chimney puffs curls up steadily. The spoon pinwheel turns slowly and steadily in place on its pretzel stick. The scoop mailbox stays fixed and faces the same way; only its little pink flag wiggles. The air is calm: only the grass sways gently and the clouds drift slowly; the sky island bobs gently in place.
cottage.structure: The cottage follows cottage@normal: waffle-cone roof with a cream swirl and strawberry, biscuit chimney on the right slope, cream body with icing trim, pink door and two blue windows.
cottage.structure_note: RCA 2026-10-22 (user: 'why is the roof cut?'): K3-v10 needed the roof above the medium shot's top edge; a codex outpaint invented it as a flat-topped roof because no SSOT described the set's structure and the key was not compared to the wide canon frame. Rule: a revealed set part comes from a crop of an approved canon frame when one shows it; outpaint only when none does, and then compare side by side with the canon frame before any paid call. Sheet = the master (user 2026-10-22: 'make a sheet and tag it'); the structure text is the short tag carried where a frames call cannot attach the sheet. Book art cottage.png is a different design (blue thatch); the shorts keep the user-approved K1 cottage.
cottage.sheet_source: pack/props-grid-5.png (same file as items.sheet). Was the 2x2 crop grid pack/props-grid-4.png and before that the 3x3 pack/props-grid.png (both archived).

still_parts.air: A soft breeze comes in gentle, uneven gusts; clouds keep their places in the background and only drift a little inside the frame — no cloud enters, crosses or leaves the frame.
still_parts.meadow: The strawberry blossoms sway and nod on their stems, each at its own rhythm; the grass ripples across the meadow in soft waves.
still_parts.trees: The distant cotton-candy trees far behind the cottage sway softly in place.
still_parts.contact: Whatever Moa touches reacts: her ears and neckerchief flutter in the breeze.
still_parts.chimney: Soft white puffs curl up steadily from the biscuit chimney.
still_parts.pinwheel: The spoon-pinwheel turns slowly and steadily in place, its spoon-shaped blades staying sharp and countable; it never stops or reverses.
still_parts.mailbox: The scoop-mailbox stays fixed and faces the same way; its pink flag wiggles and bounces on every gust.
still_parts.island: The sky island bobs gently in place.
still_parts.petals: A breeze lifts a few tiny white petals with pink-tinted tips from the berry bed in a steady trickle; they flutter and drift away.
